
**Cleaner (all languages in subfolders):**
```
docs/
├── en/
│ ├── index.md
│ ├── ambition.md
│ └── education/
├── fr/
│ ├── index.md
│ ├── ambition.md
│ └── education/
├── de/
│ └── ...
```

The second approach is cleaner because:
- All languages are treated equally
- Clear separation of content
- Easier to see what's translated and what's missing
- More scalable as content grows
